source_differences: SRD Wolf has STR14, Darkvision60, Perception+5 and Bite1d6+2 with automatic Prone against Medium-or-smaller. Crown seed has STR12, Bite2d4+1, Pack Tactics and no prone rider.

retained_runtime_observations.boundary: Read-only code observation, not gameplay verification: after a hit poison_save/restrain/paralyze_save call saving_throw_to_dc and add_condition with max(1,duration) turn count; corrode_armor adds AC-1 modifier for duration default10 rather than damaging a carried armor copy. reduce_max_hp uses existing damage receipt and direct maxHP mutation. Do not treat these simplified interpretations as source rules or replace them here.
